pages.text: Broken Vein Stone Body is the body-cultivator physique: max Qi is only one tenth of normal, but it can still absorb Qi and break through. It grants max health x2, permanent Resistance I and Regeneration I, and all melee weapon physical damage +100%. Innate Sword Body is the extreme sword physique: sword damage and sword spell costs are greatly improved, while non-sword elemental spells are heavily rejected.
This points toward a future body-cultivation path. It already changes gameplay, while the full body-cultivation system remains future work.
